name: Rosé Lace Balconette Bra
description: Underwired, lightly padded cups in fully lined floral lace, built to push you up and put you shamelessly on show — and adjustable satin straps with bows that slide off your shoulders at the lightest tug. Let them look. Then let them try. Hand wash cold, after.
fitNote: Underwired cups that lift, frame and show off — take your usual size; the straps do the rest.

name: Rosé Lace High-Waist Brief
description: Proof that full coverage can be downright filthy: soft floral lace cut high on the waist, a scalloped edge that traces your hips, and a cotton gusset where it counts. Pair it with the Rosé balconette and make them earn the whole set — slowly, piece by piece. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Sits high on the waist and hugs without digging in — snug in all the right places. True to size.

name: Camille Satin Bow Bralette
description: Silky stretch satin, wire-free with removable pads, and a single hand-tied bow at the centre doing all the work of keeping it on. Hand someone the ribbon and see how long their manners last. Machine wash delicate.
fitNote: Soft, wire-free and easy to slip out of, with a touch of give — between sizes, size down.
moments: one slow tug of a ribbon

name: Juliette Lace Bodysuit
description: Fully lined lace that clings from a plunging sweetheart neckline all the way down — sculpted, sheer and utterly shameless, with a hook-and-eye gusset for when neither of you can wait for the rest of it to come off. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Clings close through the body, exactly as it should — if you're long in the torso, go one size up.

name: Margot Silk Slip
description: Pure mulberry silk cut on the bias, so it pours over you and slides off with even less effort, under a lace-trimmed neckline that dips just low enough to start something. Wear nothing underneath. Nobody will ask why. Dry clean recommended.
fitNote: Bias-cut silk that skims rather than clings — it’s meant to slide. Your usual size.
moments: one strap slipping, then the other

name: Amélie Garter Belt
description: A stretch lace waistband, four adjustable straps and gold-tone metal clasps — made to hold your stockings up and drag their eyes all the way down. Leave it on longest: four clasps, undone one by one, is the sweetest kind of torture for whoever you’ve decided may try. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Stretch lace waist with four adjustable straps — true to size, and yours to fasten.

name: Pearl Seduction Bikini
description: Ivory satin triangles, fully lined and hanging on nothing but strands of pearls — a pearl halter, pearl sides, a barely-there cut and a cheeky back that turns every walk to the bar into a show. Pearls this wicked belong on a sunlounger. Hand wash cold, and keep your pearls out of the chlorine, darling.
details: Hand wash cold; keep the pearls out of chlorine
fitNote: Fully adjustable pearl halter and sides — take your usual size and set them as daring as you like.
moments: the long walk back from the sea
blurb: Satin and pearls, and very nearly nothing else.

name: Scarlet Sin Bikini
description: Crimson, fully lined and tied on with bows that beg to be pulled — an adjustable halter, back ties and a tie-side Brazilian bottom that leaves your behind out in the sun. A few knots from a scandal; you choose who pulls them. Quick-dry and chlorine resistant — you’ll be wet a lot.
fitNote: Tie-side bottom and an adjustable halter — your usual size, tied as tight as you dare and as loose as you’ll get away with.
moments: being pulled back into the water
blurb: Crimson strings, begging to be pulled.

name: Noir Temptress Bikini
description: Matte black, fully lined and buckled on in gold — a double-strap thong bottom and a criss-cross strappy back that looks like a dare and wears like one. Every buckle comes undone with one hand. You decide whose.
fitNote: The buckled straps sit snug and hold tight — between sizes, go up one.
moments: turning every head, then choosing one
blurb: Black straps, gold buckles, one wicked thong.

name: Golden Goddess Bikini
description: Liquid-gold metallic foil, fully lined, that catches the sun and every stare on the beach — halter and back ties up top, a high tie-side bottom and a cheeky back that leaves almost nothing to imagine and everything to want. Gold this hot is meant to be untied in the shade. Rinse in cool water after — you’ll be too hot to handle.
details: Rinse in cool water after wear
fitNote: Ties at the neck, back and hips, so it fits exactly how you tie it — and comes off exactly how you untie it. True to size.
moments: golden hour, and what comes after

name: Vesper Strap Cage Set
description: An elastic strap cage ringed in gold wraps you over fully lined micro triangle cups and a triple-strap micro G-string — more skin than lingerie, every strap something to hold on to. Wear it for you; they can look if they behave. Hand wash cold.
details: Elastic strap cage with gold O-rings
fitNote: A snug strap cage that holds on tight — size up if you're between sizes.

name: Élodie Split Babydoll
description: Lined lace balconette cups and a split-front chiffon skirt that falls open every time you move, over a micro lace G-string — sheer, floaty and made to be lifted, untied and pushed aside by whoever you invite closer. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Floats from the bust and falls open at the front — size down for a closer fit.
moments: evenings that never make it out

name: Noémie Plunge Teddy
description: Fluid champagne satin over fully lined cups, plunging all the way to your navel, with side cut-outs and a thong back — one thin strap away from nothing at all, and that strap was never going to stay put. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Fluid satin with stretch through the sides, so it moves when you do. True to size.
moments: a trench coat and nothing else
the moment the strap gives up

name: Sabine Crystal Set
description: Mocha satin micro triangles, lined and edged in crystal chain, a body chain that spills down your stomach and a crystal-strap G-string — it glitters in the dark, covers almost nothing and chimes softly with every move, so they always know exactly where you are. Hand wash and lay flat.
details: Crystal chain edging and body chain
fitNote: Adjustable chains and straps — your usual size, every link sitting where you want eyes.
moments: the sound of it coming off

name: Sakura Silk Kimono Set
description: A short wine satin kimono with wide sleeves that slip off your shoulders and fall open over a lined lace plunge bra and a matching lace thong — all held shut by one sash, tied loosely enough for a single slow pull. Answer the door in it. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: The kimono is loose and wraps to fit, the easier to slip off; the bra and thong are true to size.
moments: one slow pull of the sash

name: Delilah Backless String Dress
description: Black satin, lined cups, a micro mini hem — and a back that simply isn’t there: bare from your shoulders to the base of your spine, laced shut with thin criss-cross strings. Walk in facing them. Leave with your back to the room and an invitation in every string. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: The ties lace it as close as you like, and loosen just as fast — your usual size.

name: Rouge Eyelash Lace Bodysuit
description: Red eyelash lace over lined cups, plunging to your navel and cut so high on the hip it’s practically a rumour, with a thong back and a strappy open back to finish — the bodysuit that does all the talking, and never says anything you could repeat at dinner. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Cut close and indecently high — long in the torso? Go one size up.
moments: a hotel bar, then the room
making an entrance, then an exit

name: Ibiza Plunge Swimsuit
description: Wine red, plunging to the navel and cut so high on the leg it barely counts as a swimsuit — a halter neck, a back left wide open down to a thong, and nothing to wonder about except what happens back at the villa. Chlorine resistant, so you can stay in as long as they keep staring.
fitNote: Two bands, one halter and not much else — if you're tall, take a size up.
moments: every eye on you, one pair invited closer

name: Mykonos Chain Bikini
description: Micro triangles, fully lined, swinging from gold-tone chain at the neck, back and hips over a micro thong — dripping in metal, barely dressed in fabric, and cold against warm skin for exactly one delicious second. Rinse after wear.
details: Gold-tone chain halter, back and sides
fitNote: Gold-tone chains adjust at the neck and back, and unhook just as easily. True to size.

name: Tulum Crochet Bikini
description: Hand-crochet with lined cups, shell-bead tassels on every tie and a crochet micro G-string — an open-weave bikini that lets the sun through, hides almost nothing and dares them to go looking for the rest. Hand wash cold.
fitNote: Hand-crochet with a soft, clingy stretch — size down for a closer fit.
moments: salt in your hair and sand everywhere else

name: Saint-Tropez Cut-out Monokini
description: More cut-out than swimsuit: a single lined panel plunging to your navel, side cut-outs that bare your whole waist and a thong back. It counts as a one-piece the way a wink counts as hello.
fitNote: Sculpted and close-fitting, with your waist on show — between sizes, go up one.
moments: tan lines they’ll want to trace

name: Capri Bandeau Bikini
description: A strapless black micro bandeau that’s only just staying up and a high-sided cheeky thong that isn’t even trying — sleek, minimal and one dive away from a scandal. Whoever’s waiting at the pool’s edge, make them wait longer. Rinse after wear.
fitNote: Strapless and snug, with no give, so it stays up until you decide otherwise — size up if unsure.

name: Maldives O-Ring Bikini
description: Gold-tone O-rings link glossy, fully lined ivory over a micro tanga on high side straps that bare your hips — sun-drenched, sinful, and every ring just the right size for a finger to hook through. Quick-dry, so you never have to cover up.
fitNote: High side straps adjust at the hips, as high as you dare. True to size.
moments: a honeymoon glow, and the reason for it

name: Bora Scrunch Bikini
description: Ruched, lined triangles up top that lift, a scrunch-back micro bottom that shows off your behind like it’s the main event — because it is — and a leg cut so high they’ll lose their train of thought wondering where it ends. Quick-dry, slow burn.
fitNote: Ruched to lift and sculpt everything worth showing off — your usual size.

name: Vixen Cut-out Bandage Mini
description: Sculpting black bandage knit that holds you tight wherever it bothers to cover you, sweeping cut-outs that bare your waist and ribs, a low scoop, a strappy open back and a micro hem that rides up whenever you move. The dress for nights you don’t plan on going home alone — or going home at all.
fitNote: Sculpting bandage knit that grips you close — size up if between sizes.

name: Siren Chainmail Mini
description: Chainmail mesh so fine it pours like liquid, with a lined front, a cowl plunge on a halter neck, a back bared to the base of your spine and a side split cut sky-high. It goes on like warm metal, moves like sin and slides off like water — usually at about two in the morning.
fitNote: Halter-tied with a fluid drape that one pull undoes. True to size.
moments: catching the light, and someone’s eye

name: Muse Double-Slit Gown
description: Floor-length heavy satin with a lined bodice — and don’t let the length fool anyone: a plunge to the navel, slits to the hip on both sides and an open back. Every step is a reveal, every reveal is deliberate, and the whole ballroom knows it.
fitNote: Heavy satin with a fitted bodice that holds you just so. Your usual size.

name: Desire Latex Micro Dress
description: Glossy lined latex with corset boning and lace-up sides, cut to a micro hem — a second skin with nowhere to hide and nothing you’d want to. Lace it tight, then make them earn every lace on the way out.
fitNote: Latex with corset boning and zero stretch, so it squeezes like it means it — go up one size.

name: Lola Fringe Micro Dress
description: Every strand of hand-beaded fringe swings as you move, over a plunging halter, open sides and a micro length — the beads part to flash everything in between, so keep moving. Nobody in the room is looking at anything else, and that’s the whole point.
fitNote: Fringe that swings with every move and a forgiving cut — size down if between.

name: Nightshade Plunge Mini
description: Blush satin plunging to a deep V between lined cups, skimming you close and stopping high on the thigh, with an open back that drops to the waist under thin straps crossed over bare skin. Barely held on, barely trying, and gone the moment the zip comes down.
details: Open back with thin cross straps
fitNote: Adjustable straps and a side zip that comes down fast. True to size.
moments: dinner that ends at the door

name: Bijou Crystal Two-Piece
description: A lined, crystal-embellished bralette over a micro skirt slit high and dripping in crystal fringe, with your whole midriff on show in between — catching every light and every eye in the room, then going home with only the one you choose. Specialist clean only.
fitNote: Adjustable bralette and a micro skirt fitted to show off — your usual size.
moments: sparkling long after the party’s over

name: Fleur Embroidered Satin Slip
description: Demure on one side, depraved on the other: ivory satin down one half, sheer tulle sewn with pastel blossoms down the other, so one hip is always on show. Embroidered cups edged in flowers, a satin bow under the bust, a scalloped lace hem split at the front and a back scooped open almost to the waist. Nothing underneath required — and, frankly, nothing underneath expected. Hand wash cold.
details: Satin with a sheer embroidered tulle side panel
Lined embroidered cups with a flower trim
Open scooped back with a hook band
fitNote: Skims the body with adjustable straps, one hip always showing. Your usual size.
moments: being unwrapped slowly, then not slowly

name: Lotus Satin Cheongsam
description: Buttoned up to the throat and wide open everywhere else. Ivory satin jacquard woven with blossoms and edged in black piping, a mandarin collar fastened with a black frog button, a keyhole cut exactly where you want eyes, and a single front panel buttoned at the corners. The sides are slit from the hem all the way up to your arms, and the back is bare to the waist above a short gathered skirt. Every button is a promise — let them keep it, one at a time. Hand wash cold.
details: Mandarin halter collar with frog button
Open sides, slit hem to underarm
fitNote: Halter neck and open sides, made to flatter — fits most busts; your usual size.
moments: being unbuttoned, one at a time

name: Scarlet Butterfly Teddy
description: A scarlet butterfly landed on your chest and has no plans to leave. Lined satin cups shaped as wings, every vein raised in red thread, scalloped edges and long tails trailing down your waist. A satin choker holds it at the throat, a single thin strap runs down your stomach to a G-string finished with two satin rosettes, and the back is nothing but straps — and straps were made to be tugged. Hand wash cold.
details: Lined satin butterfly cups with vein embroidery
Centre strap to a rosette G-string
Strappy open back with hook band
fitNote: Adjustable straps and choker, set as snug as you like. Your usual size.
moments: making them forget their own name

name: Bloom Lace-Up Ruffle Mini
description: Pretty print, filthy intentions. Watercolour blossoms on fine stretch mesh, lined cups laced together down the middle with criss-cross ties over bare cleavage, and soft ruffles cascading all the way to the opposite hip. One side gathers into a ruched drawstring you can pull as high as you dare — or hand the string to someone you trust with it — finished with a flirty ruffle hem. Hand wash cold.
details: Lined cups with a lace-up centre
fitNote: Stretchy and bodycon, with an adjustable side drawstring — the hemline’s up to you. Your usual size.

name: Jade Dragon Cheongsam
description: Prim at the collar, scandalous everywhere below it. Black stretch satin crawling with pink and champagne dragons, every edge bound in bright gold piping, a mandarin collar fastened with a gold frog button, and an open bust that comes with a pair of black heart pasties — and nothing else. The back opens into a keyhole down to your shoulder blades and the skirt is slit high on both sides, frog buttons and all. Hand wash cold.
details: Printed stretch satin with gold piping
Mandarin halter collar with frog button
High side slits with frog buttons
fitNote: Stretch satin with a halter collar that hugs as it should. Your usual size.
moments: dressing up for you, undressing for them

name: Wisteria Embroidered Bustier Set
description: A garden in bloom, laced tight around your waist. Underwired embroidered balconette cups push you up and out, a sheer mesh midriff blossoms with flowers, and satin ribbons criss-cross up both sides and tie in bows begging to be undone — you choose whose fingers get the honour. With a matching embroidered thong on double strings. Hand wash cold.
details: Embroidered tulle with lined balconette cups
Satin ribbon lacing at both sides
fitNote: Underwired with adjustable straps and side lacing to cinch you in tight. Your usual size.

name: Amethyst Sin Sling Bodysuit
description: Sheer halter straps fall from a choker collar into a deep, daring V, with a band of floral lace across the middle that hides almost nothing and pretends otherwise. Ease the straps aside and let them take their sweet time finding out what’s underneath. Hand wash cold.
blurb: Sheer lilac straps, one lace secret. Size down.
details: Sheer halter straps with choker neckband
fitNote: Runs large, so size down for the sling to cling close and the V to sit exactly where you want eyes.
